# SEQ-001/A1 — Take the root lock by exclusive directory creation

<!-- session-flow:scope -->
The first coordinator creates the lock directory exclusively and records host, coordinator, and
token ownership; a later coordinator is refused until that owner releases or is proven gone.
<!-- /session-flow:scope -->
